newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Soccer-FAI Cup semi-final and premier division tie.
newsitem.headline: Soccer-FAI Cup semi-final and premier division tie.

text.p: Friday's Football Association of Ireland (FAI) Cup semi-final and national league of Ireland premier division fixtures. All kick-off times are given in GMT.
Waterford United vs Shelbourne at Waterford Regional Sports Centre, 1945 GMT.
Bohemians vs Derry City at Dalymount Park, 1930 GMT.
National league of Ireland premier division fixtures
Dundalk vs Sligo Rovers at Oriel Park, 1945 GMT.
